title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2609.37379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates, with recurrent blocks predicting implicit targets at each depth. Our framework derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer update rule. Mapping representative loop transitions into this framework reveals mismatches between their transitions and projections. We first align the input maps of existing transitions. translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享的Transformer块，提供了一种参数高效的深度扩展方法。近期的推理模型同样凸显了通过更长的计算轨迹来扩展测试时计算的价值。然而，如何设计有效的循环转换，其原理仍然知之甚少。我们将循环的隐状态视为在整个深度中不断更新的快速权重，并将循环转换形式化为基于梯度的局部更新，其中循环块在每个深度处预测隐式目标。我们的框架从投影、局部目标和优化器更新规则出发，以闭式形式推导出循环转换。将代表性的循环转换映射到该框架中，揭示了其转换与投影之间的不匹配。我们首先对齐了现有转换的输入映射，随后推导出OperLoop，它结合了显式权重衰减、自适应步长以及……
tldr: 本文将循环Transformer的循环转换形式化为基于梯度的局部更新，并据此推导出结合显式权重衰减与自适应步长的新型循环转换方法OperLoop。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates loop transitions in looped Transformers as local gradient-based updates and derives OperLoop, a novel loop transition combining explicit weight decay and adaptive step sizes.
